Maya (Partnerships): Quick sync  we have a LangChain connector pilot request that needs a lean onramp: marketplace tile, adapter QA, SI playbook, and HW validation (EdgeBox + Sigma). Who can pick what?
Diego (Eng-Platform): I can own adapter QA + staging helm. Need connector spec and preferred auth mode (api_key or mTLS).
Ozan (LangChain PM): We'll provide API-key by default and a small runner image. Uploading assets to https://drive.example/lc/connector-mini today.
Rina (Product): I'll draft marketplace metadata and a private-pilot SKU. Proposal: "invite-only 30d pilot".
Priyanka (Eng-ML): For HW validation I'll run INT8 perf sweeps and tokenization parity on small/medium/large payloads. Need autoscale off for reproducibility.
Nora (Marketing): I'll prep embargoed partner blurb and an internal one-pager. Recommend invite webinar at T+12 and public blog at T+21.
deploy-bot: Preview deploy scheduled: lc-mini-connector -> staging at 2025-09-20T15:00Z (id: db_7721).
Diego (Eng-Platform): Compat snippet to test:
```
POST /v1/generate -> streaming:true, chunk_size:128
POST /v1/call -> supports_tools:true
compat_tag: "lc-0.36"
```
Maya (Partnerships): Owners: Diego (QA), Rina (marketplace), Priyanka (HW), Nora (comms), Ozan (assets). Timeline draft: assets EOD Tue, staging + smoke T+2, legal signoff T+7, invite webinar T+12, public announce T+21. I'll send invites and a short checklist. Thanks! :rocket:
